BREAKING: $UNH 8-K filed Nov 9 — a CEO change: “Madeline Bell Joins UnitedHealth Group Board of Directors Bell, former president and CEO of Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP), is joining UnitedHealth Group’s …” How do you read it? #8K #leadership

What the filing says
“Madeline Bell Joins UnitedHealth Group Board of Directors Bell, former president and CEO of Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP), is joining UnitedHealth Group’s (NYSE: UNH) Board of Directors, effective immediately. Madeline had a …
… distinguished four-decade career at CHOP, where she started as a pediatric staff nurse in 1983.”
The filing: 8-K Item 5.02 (a director or officer leaving, joining or changing pay), filed 2026-11-09.
